steps: Desk agent enters the case number in the AI workspace → case fetched from the CRM
Queries the payment gateway and reservation system for payment and existing booking → status shown
Booking already exists? yes → step 9 / no → step 3a: payment failed? yes → [HUMAN] escalate to team lead / no → step 4
Searches flights on route and date, shows options → option list
Agent confirms the flight, consulting the passenger if needed → selection
Reserves seats and enrols each passenger; applies senior discount; asks for infant allocation → enrolled passengers
Agent confirms contact details ('yes') and the booking summary ('confirm') → approved summary
Generates payment link and sends by email and SMS; agent calls the passenger → link sent
Detects payment, retrieves booking reference, updates and closes the CRM case → closed case with audit trail
Payment taken but no booking, or an integration down → critical escalation to team lead and platform support in parallel
Rebooked passenger and closed case in under 5 minutes → less manual system switching
Email lands in the service or complaints inbox → email integration creates one ticket per thread
Fires once on ticket creation and calls the support agent → one AI action
Agent scans title, body, sender and display name for authority signals → authority flag
Authority or regulatory sender? yes → classify as complaint, zero reply, human queue / no → step 5
Classifies category and sub-category, applies inbox and email-type rules, searches KB, masks PII → structured output
Sets category, sub-category, group atomically → routed ticket
Reply allowed and KB content found? yes → step 8 / no → fallback template or silent routing to human
Posts the multilingual KB reply as an external comment → customer email, stage awaiting customer
No reply within N days → resolved then closed; customer follow-ups go to humans → closed or human-owned ticket
Complaints and regulator mail handled in the complaints group → human resolution
Fewer manual touches with regulator-safe automation → lower triage load
Scheduled sync (daily by default, intraday where needed, monthly for close packs) → source pulls
Connectors pull read-only from ERP exports, DMS, POS, e-commerce, planning tool, HRMS and file drops, deltas only → staged data
Quality gate checks freshness, duplicates, missing keys and control totals → pass or block insights
Gate passed? yes → step 5 / no → insights blocked and data owner alerted
Maps to the common grain (SKU, pack size, channel, month) in the knowledge graph with lineage and permissions → trusted base
Finance and planning agents run versioned rules for price bridge, COGS, forecast and plan vs actual; model explains, drafts → draft outputs
Finance and planners approve key outputs at each gate → approved figures
Availability control tower raises debounced alerts with causes and next actions → exceptions
Delivers via app, email, team chat, spreadsheet or PDF with data-as-of time; audit log and value ledger → governed delivery
Automated explainable monthly close and earlier stock-out flags → time and working-capital gains
Dealer opens the support chat in the DMS → greeting and main menu
Taps one of 5 entry buttons → use case chosen
Shows 1-2 sub-menus of error, reason or option buttons (max 3 taps) → scenario identified
Issue listed? yes → step 5 / no → step 5 with the Others path (open describe-your-issue mode)
Talk-to-agent node passes context: use case, scenario, path, start turn, already-answered list → agent invoked
Dealer and branch IDs come from the DMS session and are never asked; no re-asking of menu answers → clean first turn
Sends the first scripted instruction or data request, then runs the procedure sheet from the set turn → resolution steps or collected details
Resolved by the instructions? yes → step 9 / no → agent continues the sheet or hands the details to support
Closes with outcome, reason and a 1-5 star rating → closing record
Dealer reaches the right procedure in at most 3 taps without repeated questions → faster self-service
Planner asks in chat, or the monthly/weekly schedule fires → planning request
Exports from ERP, validated-batch-size system, quality-event system and validation planner load as-is into linked objects → reconciled data
Readiness skill checks master documents, MES recipe, open quality items, equipment requalification and materials per line → Ready / At risk / Blocked with blocker and owner
Batch-and-machine skill applies R1-R3 to demand and rounds to whole batches → batch sizes
Only equipment validated for the batch size and in date on requalification is used; others flagged with reason → compliant assignment
Groups batches sharing a blend to reduce non-serial changeovers → sequence and changeover saving
Any line blocked or equipment lapsed? yes → flag with source record for the owner / no → include in draft plan
Produces the machine-level draft plan with rationale per batch → plan pack
Planner and quality SME review and approve; no write-back to source systems → approved plan
Draft in about one hour and plan ready earlier, with zero violations → planner capacity released
Business user asks a question in natural language → request with persona
Persona access control and region/brand scope applied before any query → scoped request
Catalog sync pulls table and column metadata from Google BigQuery → governed metadata catalog
Reads guidance, synonym map and field annotations; resolves metric and entities → query plan
Native text-to-SQL can see the custom fields? yes → step 6 / no → step 7
Generates SQL at runtime from the catalog and runs it on BigQuery → result set
Calls the domain query skill or cross-domain join skill → result set
Answers with table, period and scope using business labels, refusing schema enumeration and out-of-scope data → answer
Logs tokens, cost and response time per query → cost and latency record
QA reviewers score the harness run against ground truths computed outside the platform → pass rate
Self-serve answers with consistency to certified reports and transparent cost → fewer analyst tickets
Observability platform raises an alert, or a ticket arrives by email, portal or team chat → event
Auto incident tracking: alerts are correlated, de-duplicated and opened as a tracked incident linked to affected tickets → incident
Fires once on creation and calls the main agent → one AI action
AI triage: scans for P1/P2 emergency signals, classifies type, category, priority → structured output
P1/P2 or change request? yes → step 6 / no → step 7
No AI reply; route to on-call queue or approval board → human-only handling
Searches KB and runbooks; for alerts, graph lookup and on-demand cloud log and metric pulls → grounded context
Drafts the reply or customer notification and SOP checklist, or NO_RESPONSE → draft
Reviews, personalises and approves send (100% on customer-impacting actions; supervised mode early on) → sent communication
Awaiting-requester stage then auto-resolve and close after N days of silence; incident resolution closes linked tickets → closed records
Alert-to-customer notice and human touch-time under 5 minutes → more customers per team
User opens the embedded chat widget with a verified identity (user and tenant) → session
Asks a product, how-to or account question → request
Answers from help articles, approved Q&A and SOPs, giving name, path and button label → answer
Account-specific issue? yes → step 5 / no → step 8
Tenant taken from verified identity only; any user-supplied tenant or customer ID is ignored → isolated scope
Runs read-only diagnosis queries (customer lookup, pool status, collectible status, ranking filter) → reasons
Explains each reason then the fix → explained answer
User confirms it helped? yes → close without ticket / no → step 9
User confirms an agent-drafted, categorized summary; ticket is created and linked to the conversation; support reviews per tier → categorized ticket
Fewer avoidable tickets and cleaner handoffs → lower support load
Shopper sends a message on messaging or email → conversation opened with unified identity and cross-channel memory
Understands the request in natural language and picks a skill → skill call
Reads live order, tracking, refund or catalogue data from the source systems → verified facts
Is the request an action (return, exchange, cancel)? yes → step 5 / no → step 8
Checks per-item eligibility against window and policy → verdict
Files the return/exchange or cancels the unshipped order and triggers the refund → record in order and returns systems
Replies with status, answer or product results → resolved conversation (deflected)
Receives handover with sentiment and severity classification, works the chat or ticket with SLA and CSAT → human resolution
Self-served conversation or escalated case with full context → deflection and zero broken journeys
